(2013) proved that UFOs and WAs are simply different parts of a single large-scale stratified outflow in the AGN, confirming a unified model for accretion powered sources (Kazanas et al. 2012). Alternative suggestions that UFOs and WAs may represent distinct outflows with different conditions have been ruled out (Laha et al. 2014, 2016).
